scripts.compact: COMPACT_CMD="compact compile +0.31.1"; if command -v compactc >/dev/null 2>&1 && compactc --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then COMPACT_CMD="compactc"; fi; rm -rf src/managed/* && name=$(basename $(ls src/*.compact) .compact) && $COMPACT_CMD src/$name.compact src/managed/$name && sed -i 's/.*checkRuntimeVersion.*//g' src/managed/$name/contract/index.js
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p ./dist && cp -Rf ./src/managed ./dist/managed && cp ./src/*.compact ./dist && find ./dist/managed -name index.js -exec sed -i 's/.*checkRuntimeVersion.*//g' {} +
scripts.dev: npm run compact && npm run build
